# biznetgio_neolite_ip_availability (Data Source)

Cek ketersediaan public IP untuk product NEO Lite.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_neolite_products" "all" {}

data "biznetgio_neolite_ip_availability" "this" {
  product_id = data.biznetgio_neolite_products.all.products[0].product_id
}

output "available" {
  value = data.biznetgio_neolite_ip_availability.this.available
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_id` (Number) Product id NEO Lite.

### Read-Only

- `available` (Boolean) True kalau IP tersedia.
- `id` (String) Data source id statis.
